sample.holdout_definition: SHA256(split_seed + NUL + S1 ID) integer mod 5 == 1; this bucket is disjoint from other hash buckets
sample.sample_method: population-proportional stratified bottom-k by match class x country within holdout pool
sample.sample_selection_storage: SQLite temporary file; full ground truth and holdout pool are not retained in Python memory
